To take a great tour-caliber Wedge and make it even better, you start from the ground up. Literally. Introducing all-new RTZ Wedges with Z-Alloy. It's a totally new, zero-compromise formula that gives RTZ Wedges out-of-this-world feel, forgiveness, and consistency. The best part? We're just getting started.

settings.title: Z-ALLOY
settings.text: Z-Alloy is a brand-new steel created by Cleveland Golf for a better feel. It's softer, lighter, and remarkably durable. It gives CBZ Wedges superior feel, better forgiveness, and more consistency.

settings.title: CAVITY BACK DESIGN
settings.text: Thanks to CBZ's cavity back design and ZipCore Technology, the sweet spot is central - instead of heel-sided, where you're most likely to contact the ball. And since it's packed with MOI, you'll hit more successful shots more often.

settings.title: GELBACK TPU
settings.text: For anyone still unfamiliar with Gelback TPU's feel benefits: this specially designed TPU insert sits behind the sweet spot to help dampen vibrations and enhance feel on every shot, so even miss-his are buttery smooth.

settings.title: HYDRAZIP
settings.text: HydraZip's face blasts and laser-milled lines maximize spin in wet conditions. Dynamically configured by loft groupings, it balances spin across lofts while enhancing performance in adverse weather.

settings.title: UTILIZIP
settings.text: UtiliZip's sharper grooves cut through grass and debris at contact, while deeper grooves help make space for grass, sand, dirt, or water to clear the impact zone, giving CBZ Wedges stronger, more consistent spin from the fairway, rough, or bunker.

settings.title: ZIPCORE
settings.text: This low-density core technology replaces heavier material in the heel and hosel area with a lightweight material. This proprietary core allows us to shift the Center of Gravity closer to where you strike the ball, while simultaneously adding MOI.
FULL-FACE DESIGN OPTION

A fan favorite versatility option, our Full-Face design returns with CBZ. Full-Face allows golfers who make inconsistent contact to receive more spin on off-center shots. And, for savvier players, its hosel-to-toe grooves and extended, high-toe toe area maximize contact on creative open-face shots for more consistent spin, flight, and stopping power.

We filled every millimeter of that with our UltiZip groove pattern and HydraZip face treatment. All so you can strike it anywhere, in any conditions, and enjoy this incredibly versatile short-game tool.

Starring an attractive, optimal high-toe shape that stays true to our Cleveland Golf roots, this one's built for creative open-face shots and to complement your touch around the greens—all while knowing you're covered, wherever you strike it, when the Wedge slides under the ball.

settings.title: GAP WEDGE
settings.text: Our V-Shaped sole with 12° of bounce and a traditional head and groove length prevent digging on full swing shots, even if you strike slightly behind the ball.

settings.title: SAND WEDGE
settings.text: Our S-Shaped sole with an increased 14° of bounce is ideal for bunker shots or more finesse type shots from the rough or fairway, helping you get in and out of the sand or turf without losing speed.

settings.title: LOB WEDGE
settings.text: Our C-Shaped sole is perfect for lob shots with an open-face. Includes additional heel and toe side relief to give you options in any greenside situation you may encounter.
